description: Negative, superseded or recommendation-discordant clinical oncology evidence retained separately from the active trial-page queue. Items are not new uploads.

items.reason: Phase III: 8-year MFS-CI 74% vs 72%, HR 0.88 (95% CI 0.67–1.15), P=0.34; no overall MFS-CI or OS improvement. Prespecified pelvic-node RT subgroup (n=324) showed HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.29–0.76), adjusted P=0.004; interpret as subgroup signal, not overall success.
items.next_action: Retain for contrary-evidence synthesis on ARPI intensification with definitive RT.

items.reason: 71,122 vs 71,128 randomized; primary stage III/IV incidence IRR 1.03 (95% CI 0.92–1.14), P=0.63. Stage IV IRR 0.86 (95% CI 0.74–1.00) after three rounds; further follow-up required.
items.next_action: Retain for screening-policy contrary-evidence review; do not claim mortality benefit.

items.site: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.reason: Randomized phase II: 69 randomized, 66 treated; ORR 15.6% with danvatirsen+pembrolizumab vs 14.3% with pembrolizumab, risk difference 1.3, P=1.0; stopped for lack of response.
items.next_action: Retain as negative STAT3/PD-1 combination evidence.

items.reason: PFS 8.4 vs 6.7 months, HR 0.76 (95% CI 0.48–1.19), P=0.12; OS 20 vs 18 months, P=0.18; no significant benefit in the unselected population.
items.next_action: Retain as contrary evidence against unselected PD-1 addition to SG; do not over-interpret exploratory PD-L1 subgroup.
